_about: All kept rules on with their default parameters, nothing tuned: copy for a new board (derived In4 box, pinesc walled + twins).

bus_layer._why: protected copy of the high-current bus; everything derived (auto box = pads of the series terminals carrying >= half the net current, grown by w)
soft fill of the return net on the outer layer away from the hot loops (gives GND back the In4 area)

pad_join._why: expected per-pad findings (board data, not tuning): the charter's allowed opens (3V3 at L201 = the J301 piece seen from the other side; J301/J302 test GND) and the PD chips' small VBUS_32 supply pin (IC supply, mA, router-finished; dc_score lists it as pads_not_joined). Same list as r4_vbus/allow.json.
